correctness.rationale: At π and 4π/5, cos3θ=cos7θ, and the positive two-point combination sT(π)+T(4π/5) eliminates b,c to bound a≤(5+3√5)/10. The proposed b,c give factorization C(x+1)(x+r)²R(x), C=64(5−2√5)/25>0 and r=(1+√5)/4. Exact independent Q(√5) polynomial expansion confirms the factorization, and all six degree-five Bernstein coefficients of R((2y−1)) were independently reconstructed and are positive, implying R>0 on [−1,1]. At equality both contact points vanish; derivative at x=−r with nonsingular two-coefficient linear system establishes uniqueness.

The exact optimizing value, a globally certified feasible extremizer and uniqueness are precise reusable mathematical benchmarks; no paper-sized downstream theorem is required for this motivated exact fact.
